world_frame: MCD TUHH campus survey map frame
rationale: Reference map produced by 124-station TLS registration with sphere-target alignment <10 mm and total-station verification <5 cm. GT is map-derived (continuous-time B-spline fitted to LiDAR+IMU registered to this map). Primary evaluation metric is point-to-plane RMSE of estimated map to reference map; using the reference map frame is most direct and requires no additional transform.
tls_registration: sphere-target, residual <10 mm; total-station check <5 cm
gt_relationship: GT = continuous-time B-spline fitted to LiDAR+IMU data registered to this map (map-derived GT)
independence_note: Reference map was produced independently of this project's mapping process. GT and reference map share the same TLS base, hence GT is not a fully independent ground truth relative to the map metric.
option_2_rejected: GT body frame at t0 (VN200 IMU) requires mocap body→IMU extrinsics that are not available for night_09; blocked.
